item.text: The documentation confirms page-based order listing, bearer-token authentication, customer-level discounts, and a `next` cursor path. I’ve also confirmed unauthenticated order requests are rejected, so the collection pass will refresh tokens on authorization failures and honor server-supplied rate-limit waits.

The complete pass covered 30 pages and 1,500 listings, yielding 1,480 distinct order IDs. It encountered and recovered from 13 rate-limit responses and refreshed the short-lived token 13 times; 20 repeated listings were skipped. The computed result is 407 qualifying shipped orders totaling 9,329,707 cents. I’m writing and validating the exact JSON shape now.
